description: Breakdown reports for scripts/benchmark.py. Synthetic. They cover the inputs a manager actually gives: an alarm code, no code, Telugu, Hindi, Telugu typed in English letters, a two-word report, and a machine the plant has no manual for. `expect` is checked in code: the machine and alarm the guide must identify, and whether a manual section must be cited.
